metadata.explanation: Agent proved Settings navigation capability. This task requires navigating to Settings > Displays or the Night Light section and enabling it. Evaluator checks 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.color night-light-enabled' equals 'true'. Default is 'false', ensuring negative-control resistance.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the GNOME Night Light gsettings key 'org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.color night-light-enabled', which is the canonical system setting for Night Light on Ubuntu/GNOME.

Logic is sound: when Night Light is enabled, gsettings returns 'true\n' which contains 'true' and not 'false'; when disabled it returns 'false\n' which contains 'false' — correctly scoring 0.0.
No postconfig needed: gsettings reads system settings directly without requiring any UI dialog to be open.
Negative-control resistance is confirmed: default state is 'false', so a do-nothing agent scores 0.0.
